review_candidates.title: Cloud engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: About the Role We are seeking a skilled Cloud Engineer with 3+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure management and strong hands-on expertise in OpenStack environments. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, deploying, maintaining, and optimizing cloud infrastructure while ensuring high availability, security, and performance. Key Responsibilities Deploy, configure, and manage OpenStack cloud environments and related services. Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize cloud
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: About the Role We are seeking a skilled Cloud Engineer with 3+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure management and strong hands-on expertise in OpenStack environments. Support cloud security initiatives, including access controls, patching, and compliance requirements. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, System Administration, or Infrastructure Operations. Strong hands-on experience with OpenStack components (Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Keystone, Horizon).
